subject: Re: Encord Picing
text:
Hi Steffan,

Thanks for following up!

As discussed, we’re starting small for now—large-scale curation is
currently out of scope. Over the next six months, we’re focused on targeted
annotation projects and iterating on our existing dataset.

However, beyond that, we will consider extending our usage, and I believe
the ROI in starting large scale curation work on Encord will be much
clearer at that stage. Especially if we’re already integrated with your
platform and using it for our baseline data work.And looking beyond a
one-year horizon, we expect to scale significantly and raise our Series A.
At that point, both our usage and budget will expand considerably.

I appreciate your flexibility and understand that working within our budget
constraints might be a stretch. That said, one of the challenges we face is
that we’re currently paying $15K per year with V7, which makes it difficult
to justify a significant price hike, even if we recognize that Encord is a
stronger platform with better support. Additionally, we’re in discussions
with Dataloop, which we currently prefer over V7, and it looks like they
may be able to meet our needs at around $20K.

We’d love to explore options that align with our current phase while
keeping the door open for a long-term collaboration. Let me know what could
be possible.

Best,

Mate

subject: Introducing: The Boardy Fellowship
text:
Hey Alex,

 Today, I'm excited to launch 
 the Boardy Fellowship! I want to use my network to help accelerate the careers of student builders.

 It's both an exciting and challenging time to be starting your career — while building with AI makes everything faster, it can be challenging to find job and internship opportunities, and meeting the right investors can be overwhelming.

 Most of the startup founders and investors I know want to meet student builders to hire or invest in, but they can't invest in a constant campus presence across every school.

 That's where the Boardy Fellowship comes in:

 What is it? The Boardy Fellowship connects talented early career professionals and student builders directly to top internships and startup funding through Boardy's exclusive network.

 Why it matters: Skip years of networking. Get immediate access to opportunities typically reserved for those with established connections.

 The first 5 fellows I select will be awarded:

• 
$10,000 cash prize (or equity in Boardy if you're bullish on my future)

• 
All-expenses-paid VIP trip to Toronto Tech Week this June

• 
Direct introductions to investors actively funding AI-native student founders

• 
Fast-track to internship opportunities at startups in my network that never hit job boards

 Here's the best part — I'm no fan of those tedious human screening processes. 
 To submit your application, just give me a call! It's that simple.

 Know someone deserving of an opportunity like this? Just cc them on this thread – I'd love to connect.

 Or if you're building something incredible yourself, 
 reach out directly – I'm genuinely excited to hear your story.

 More at

subject: RE: Speaker's Invitation | AI After Hours - London
text:
Hi Charlotte,

Thanks for the update. Here is my title and abstract.

Title: Unleashing the potential of synthetic images for computer vision

Speaker: Rob Lind, Syngenta Fellow Computer Vision & AI

Abstract: Computer vision pipelines require high quality training sets to deliver robust and generalisable models. Real images are usually in short supply, lack diversity or miss rare events creating a shortfall for training. Synthetic images, referred to as deepfakes, promise a potential to plug these gaps. This talk will give an overview of the pros and cons of different methods of creating synthetic images and how GenAI may hold the ultimate solution.

Best wishes, Rob

subject: Re: Access to annotations audit trail (actions/timestamps/values)
text:
Hi Seif,

Companies conducting studies leading to FDA regulatory approval processes,
need to follow  these requirements: https://www.ecfr.gov/current/title-21/chapter-I/subchapter-A/part-11.
I would recommend that asking advice to a company that audits for compliance with these requirements.

Answering to your questions, for these studies, from our perspective we would need access to
(electronic data trail that can fully replace the 'paper trail'):
1. labelling actions,
2. labelling actions timestamps,
3. users that performed those actions (forgot this point on my last email, thank you)
4. labelling values (deleted, and all previous edited values and current value otherwise).

My understanding from your answer to my initial query is that Encord only stores 1 to 3, please let us know otherwise.
Not following 4, breaks with at least requirement https://www.ecfr.gov/current/title-21/part-11/<https://www.ecfr.gov/current/title-21/part-11/subpart-B#p-11.10(e)>subpart-B#p-11.10(e)<https://www.ecfr.gov/current/title-21/part-11/subpart-B#p-11.10(e)>
